featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We are deeply saddened by the loss of your kitten, and we sincerely understand how painful and emotional such a situation can be for any pet parent. Our heartfelt condolences are with you during this difficult time.

However, we would like to respectfully clarify certain statements made in this review.

The kitten was examined and treated based on the symptoms and diagnostic findings presented during each visit. Necessary consultations, prescriptions, medications, blood tests, IV fluids, and supportive treatments were advised according to the kitten’s condition at that time. All investigations and treatments were discussed with the owners before proceeding.

Throughout the treatment period, our doctors and staff remained in constant touch with the owners. Messages and calls were responded to promptly, including late-night communication at around 12:40 AM. Whenever concerns were raised, guidance was provided immediately.

When the owners informed us that the kitten was experiencing breathing difficulty and respiratory distress, they were advised without delay to bring the kitten to the hospital immediately for emergency treatment and monitoring. Relevant call and chat records regarding these communications are available.

After the initial treatment period at our clinic, the owners also chose to continue treatment at a government hospital. Additionally, our doctors had repeatedly advised timely vaccination for the kitten as part of preventive care. However, the owners informed us on multiple occasions that they intended to get the vaccinations done elsewhere.

It is also incorrect to state that excessive fees were charged. Each visit, including consultation, treatment, medications, and tests, was billed transparently, and no individual bill exceeded approximately ₹1100. Bills and prescriptions were provided throughout the treatment period.

The kitten’s condition involved serious complications including viral infection, jaundice, vomiting, electrolyte imbalance, and later respiratory distress. Veterinary medicine, especially in very young kittens with severe systemic illness, can sometimes involve sudden deterioration despite timely medical care and supportive treatment.

We completely understand the grief and distress associated with losing a young pet. However, we strongly deny allegations of negligence or intentional carelessness by our doctors or staff. Our team made sincere efforts to guide, treat, and support the case throughout the period the kitten was under our care.

We remain committed to providing compassionate, ethical, and responsible veterinary care to every patient entrusted to us.

featured_reviews.name: Viraal Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: The worst experience ever! Lost one of my budgies due to anaesthesia reaction. Despite informing them about it, they went ahead and compulsorily went for x-ray and blood test under sedation! All they had to do was just trim his nails because at home they don’t get those natural ways to trim themselves. They were treating my other budgie for liver issues whereas the real concern was hormonal. They don’t know anything on how to handle cases. Would never go and would never recommend this one to anybody

Taking x-rays and blood under sedation is high standard of care as per world standards. Doing so without is stressful for the patient. Anesthestic risk is unfortunate and sometimes unpredictable. That being said, we cannot force anyone into doing diagnostics. It is a choice.
We hope Yelly is healthy and happy and continues to be so.
Take care and wish you all the best.

featured_reviews.name: Ashna Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot express enough gratitude for the exceptional care my dog Tara received at Critter Care Veterinarian Clinic. Dr. Henna, Dr. Faye, Dr. Nidhi, Dr. Bhushan and the entire team went above and beyond to ensure Tara's well-being. During our first visit, they swiftly diagnosed her with TVT cancer, providing clarity and a comprehensive plan moving forward. The team at Critter Care supported us every step of the way, ensuring Tara received the treatment she needed to overcome her illness. Their dedication and hard work paid off - Tara is now cancer-free!

Even during clinic renovations, they seamlessly arranged alternative care for Tara, showcasing their unwavering commitment. I am forever grateful to the doctors at Critter Care for their compassion and expertise. Kudos to this remarkable team for their outstanding service and saving Tara's life.

featured_reviews.name: Rachel Atwood
featured_reviews.review_text: I went here because it's one of the few places that takes care of rabbits. However, I stopped taking our pet rabbit here because they weren't super responsive for issues when I wasn't physically on property with the animal. The first visit was great, and I was super happy. However, after that, the only response I'd get was: send a stool sample, with no context or information to help me understand if what I was seeing was a huge issue or nothing to worry about. After the second time they asked for that, I turned to Google and Google was way more helpful: the issue was the result of a change in diet, which they should have known considering it was their instructions that caused the change in diet (i.e. it wasn't something to worry about). Basically I got the impression that the goal was to make money only. Fine, it's a business, they should make money, but not at the expense of ensuring care for the critters they see.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We're sorry you feel this way. We do prefer to talk over the phone or face to face rather than on text especially when we're working with patients all day and can't be texting. 
We run diagnostics to rule out any serious issues because we care for our patients and want to do what's right by them. Prevention will cost way less than treating a horrific medical condition.
Feel free to come and speak to us at the clinic or call us to talk about any issues. If only Google could do our job, we wouldn't need to study and work so hard. 
Take care.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

If you give us further details, we can help figure out what went wrong.

featured_reviews.review_text:

It really feels like a second opportunity for our cat. The entire medical staff is also wonderful—very kind, friendly, and truly concerned about animals and their owners. The atmosphere is professional but caring. I definitely suggest this hospital to anyone looking for dependable and competent veterinary care.You can rest confident that your pet is in excellent hands here.
Again big thanks to Dr. Hamid for the exceptional care, support and advice.

featured_reviews.review_text:

I am extremely satisfied with the care provided by Dr. Gaurangi, whose treatment has enabled Buddy, at 11.7 years of age, to move freely without medication or pain.

Recently, a small ulcerating tumour was detected near his rectum. Initially, Dr. Hamid advised against surgery due to age-related anesthesia risks. However, after careful consideration, we decided to proceed to prevent further complications. The surgery was successfully conducted yesterday, and Buddy was discharged the same day. He is now recovering well at home.

I am sincerely grateful to Dr. Hamid, Dr. Reana, and the entire team for their dedicated care and professionalism. While the facility may be relatively expensive for some, it offers excellent medical treatment, complete transparency in processes and costs, and outstanding service.

featured_reviews.name: Shilpa Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text:
We would like to share our experience at Tata Small Animal Hospital, which has been a mix of appreciation and concern.

During our first visit, we were extremely satisfied with the services provided. The hospital environment, staff coordination, and overall approach towards small animals were professional, caring, and reassuring. Our experience was pleasant and very helpful, which is why we trusted the hospital for a follow-up consultation as well.

However, during our second visit, we felt somewhat misguided. We consulted Dr. Aishwarya Ramesh and clearly explained the reason for our visit along with our concerns, especially regarding our pet’s ongoing issue of not eating food. While she prescribed certain food and medicines, we were surprised when she advised us to visit her private clinic for the next consultation.

Unfortunately, the private clinic did not meet basic hygiene standards, which made us uncomfortable and raised concerns about continuity of care. As pet parents, we rely on reputed institutions like Tata Small Animal Hospital for transparent, ethical, and consistent guidance.

We have spent nearly ₹8,000 across two visits, yet our pet’s core issue remains unresolved. This leaves us worried about whether future visits to Tata Small Animal Hospital will ensure proper consultation and whether we might again be directed outside the hospital system.

We genuinely respect Tata Small Animal Hospital and hope our feedback is taken constructively. We would appreciate clarity on how patient care continuity is ensured and reassurance that consultations remain within the hospital framework for proper guidance and trust.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback and for trusting Tata Trusts Small Animal Hospital with your pet’s care.
We’re grateful to hear that your initial experience with our hospital was positive. It truly means a lot to us, as providing compassionate and professional care is at the core of what we do.

At the same time, we sincerely regret the concerns you faced during your follow-up visit. Your feedback regarding continuity of care and being advised to seek consultation outside the hospital has been noted with seriousness. We understand how important transparency, consistency, and trust are for pet parents, and we apologise for any discomfort or confusion this may have caused.

Please be assured that referrals or redirection of cases outside the hospital framework is not our standard practice, and this matter has been escalated internally. Appropriate and strict action will be taken to ensure such situations are addressed and do not recur.
We truly value your feedback, as it helps us strengthen our processes and uphold the standards.

Instead of giving a diagnosis, and dealing with the issue, the person accompanying Dr. Pamela, (I think Sunaina) blamed us for neglect and was very judgemental and condescending, as if we are bad pet owners. Unlike the more professional doctors in Alibaug, this woman created panic in us.

We shall be taking Mastani for treatment to more level headed and better informed professionals.

Hope you train and hire better.
